notes.content: The Bachelor of Arts in Comparative World Literature offers three (3) emphasis options: Emphasis I: World Literature in Translation. Emphasis II: Cultural Studies. Cultural Studies is the interdisciplinary study of literature and other forms of cultural expression within social and historical contexts. All courses are upper division. Emphasis III: Language and Literature. A second foreign language study is encouraged but not required for this emphasis. PLEASE REFER TO THE ENTRIES FOR THE INDIVIDUAL OPTIONS FOR SPECIFIC MAJOR PREPARATION
notes.contentHtml:
The Bachelor of Arts in Comparative World Literature offers three (3) emphasis options:

 

  • Emphasis I: World Literature in Translation.
  • Emphasis II: Cultural Studies. Cultural Studies is the interdisciplinary study of literature and other forms of cultural expression within social and historical contexts. All courses are upper division.
  • Emphasis III: Language and Literature. A second foreign language study is encouraged but not required for this emphasis.


PLEASE REFER TO THE ENTRIES FOR THE INDIVIDUAL OPTIONS FOR SPECIFIC MAJOR PREPARATION
